# PPL Hypertrophy Tracker (Push • Pull • Legs)

> Science-backed 6-Day progressive overload hypertrophy web application featuring custom workout splits, automatic rest countdown timers, Olympic plate math, 3D anatomical muscle visualization, and Supabase cloud persistence.

- **Website**: https://ppltracker.web.id
- **Repository**: https://github.com/farhanazeemi/ppl-tracker
- **License**: MIT
- **Category**: Health & Fitness Web Application / Hypertrophy Tracker

---

## Core Features & Functionality

1. **6-Day Periodized Hypertrophy Split**:
   - **Push A**: Upper Chest & Anterior Delts focus (Low Incline Dumbbell Press, Seated DB Shoulder Press, Flat Machine Press, Lateral Raises, Overhead Cable Rope Extensions, Tricep Rope Pushdowns).
   - **Pull A**: Lat Width & Upper Back Thickness (Lat Pulldowns, Chest-Supported Rows, Neutral Grip Cable Rows, Dumbbell Incline Curls, Hammer Curls, Facepulls).
   - **Legs A**: Quad Dominant & Calves (Barbell Squats/Hack Squats, Romanian Deadlifts, Leg Extensions, Seated Hamstring Curls, Standing Calf Raises).
   - **Push B**: Shoulder & Tricep Overload with Chest Maintenance (Overhead Barbell Press, Incline Machine Chest Press, Pec Deck Flys, Cable Lateral Raises, Skullcrushers).
   - **Pull B**: Upper Back & Rear Delt Emphasis (Weighted Pull-ups, T-Bar Rows, Single-arm Cable Lat Pulldowns, Preacher Curls, Incline Hammer Curls, Reverse Pec Deck).
   - **Legs B**: Posterior Chain & Hamstring Focus (Deadlifts / RDLs, Bulgarian Split Squats, Lying Leg Curls, Leg Press, Seated Calf Raises).

2. **Double Progression System**:
   - The user stays at a given working weight until all sets hit the top of the prescribed rep bracket (e.g. 3 sets of 12 reps).
   - Once the top threshold is unlocked, the system prompts the lifter to advance weight by the smallest incremental load (+2.5 kg / +5 lbs) while resetting to the bottom rep target (8 reps).

3. **Rest Timer Engine**:
   - Automated 60s, 90s, 120s, and 180s rest interval timers with audio chimes and progress ring feedback.

4. **Olympic Barbell Plate Calculator**:
   - Computes exact Olympic barbell breakdown (45 lb / 20 kg bar) displaying 25kg, 20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg, and 1.25kg plate stacks per side.

5. **Cloud Database Architecture**:
   - Built on Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS).
   - Persists user profiles (age, height, weight, fitness goal, units) and workout session histories.

6. **The Hypertrophy Science Journal (/blog)**:
   - Peer-reviewed resistance training insights, muscle hypertrophy mechanisms, exercise kinematics, and progressive overload protocols.
   - Comprehensive breakdowns on clavicular pec (upper chest) lengthened partials, low-bar squat isometrics and pin work, body recomposition energy balances, optimal protein dosing, and scapular plane deltoid abduction.
   - Fully structured with Schema.org BlogPosting, semantic Markdown, high-resolution biomechanical imagery, and machine-readable data.
